scope: Offline native chronological renderer qualification at the retained 120-tool limit. Runtime/model menu policy and runtime admission are unchanged.
implementation: Completed single plain paragraphs can use selectable, Dynamic Type native Text in a timeline. Markdown, multiline/ambiguous whitespace, code, errors and streaming prose retain the packaged WebView. Reader actions retain full-response scope and reserve space. Wrapped reasoning labels report their full height.

sharedCases.verification: Swift selection uses shared fixtures. TypeScript checks the installed parser; native WKWebView checks actual packaged paragraph tags and innerText for every selected case. Unicode combining characters and emoji joiners remain intact.

method.configuration: CovenCavePerformance Release, explicit offline fixture and instrumentation flags
method.workload: 12 or 120 typed tools; count+1 prose spans. Every tenth item has bold and inline code; final span has an inline link. No provider/network execution.
method.attachedWebViews: Actual WKWebView instances attached to app windows at each capture.
method.lifecycleCounters: Created, first successful render, invalidated and failed; invalidation is not proof of deallocation.
method.footprint: App process phys_footprint only; excludes separate WebKit processes.
method.renderSpan: Existing per-renderer first-rich stable-frame span. Reported maximum is cumulative within one journey, not whole-transcript latency or a percentile.

limitations: One journey per size/variant, without controlled host load: descriptive local observations, not p95, frame-rate/hitch distributions or performance gates.
